existing_assertions.substance: Valid flag-0 RGB triangle; public raster pixels verify its three corners, an interior blend, and outside transparency. It does not exercise continuation flags.
Low-bit flag-0 triangle validates independent 7-bit record encodings with per-vertex pad bits and public corner pixels, but all flag values are zero.
Type4-only runtime Function failure/control path; not edge topology coverage.

assertion_gap: No checked-in assertion found for Table81 flag 1 or 2, ignored flags on the second/third vertices of a flag-0 triangle, or continuity of inherited vertex colors. Existing flag-0 and bit-padding tests do not cover these branches.
candidate_test_design: The standalone exact-xref source encodes five records with BitsPerFlag=2, BitsPerCoordinate=8 and BitsPerComponent=8. Each 42-significant-bit vertex is separately padded to 48 bits in the source-authored fixture encoder. The initial flag-0 triangle uses nonzero coordinates and RGB primary corners; its second/third vertex flags are nonzero legal values that Table81 says are ignored. Next flag1 must produce (vb,vc,vd); following flag2 must produce (va,vc,vd) from that preceding triangle. Assertions compare all three display-list triangle coordinates and literal corner colors to the source's sequences. Source interpretation must be complete; xref is exact and unrecovered. No renderer-derived expected values.
verdict: T96: parent integrated exact topology oracle and it passes. Display-list topology/color assertions, not a new raster oracle.
